tasks.subject: Task 1: GestureAction component + core unit tests
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The `GestureAction<M>` component exists, renders a single non-breakable region carrying its content, and decodes a striking pen gesture (not taps, not highlighter) into one value-message.

**Files:**
- Create: `crates/inkapp-core/src/components/gesture.rs`
- Modify: `crates/inkapp-core/src/components/mod.rs` (add `pub mod gesture;`)
- Test: `crates/inkapp-core/tests/gesture_action.rs`

**Verify:** `nix develop -c cargo test -p inkapp-core --test gesture_action`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["crates/inkapp-core/src/components/gesture.rs", "crates/inkapp-core/src/components/mod.rs", "crates/inkapp-core/tests/gesture_action.rs"], "verifyCommand": "nix develop -c cargo test -p inkapp-core --test gesture_action", "acceptanceCriteria": ["new/with_msg compile", "wide pen fires; tap & highlighter do not", "render emits #region with content", "end-to-end strike decodes one message"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Harness exerciser with real captured fixtures
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Prove GestureAction against real recorded gestures through the device write/read byte path via `simulate`: strike-through & scribble-out fire; empty, highlight-swipe (wrong tool), checkmark (pen, wrong shape) do not.

**Files:**
- Modify: `crates/inkapp-harness/tests/exercisers.rs`

**Verify:** `nix develop -c cargo test -p inkapp-harness --test exercisers gesture_action_exerciser`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["crates/inkapp-harness/tests/exercisers.rs"], "verifyCommand": "nix develop -c cargo test -p inkapp-harness --test exercisers gesture_action_exerciser", "acceptanceCriteria": ["strike-through & scribble-out fire", "empty, highlight-swipe, checkmark do not fire"]}
```
